guide.summary: Bayside estates, art museums, gardens and Little Havana bars, with breakfast spots, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Plan museum days around closures: Vizcaya shuts on Tuesdays, PAMM on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, and The Bass, The Wolfsonian–FIU and ICA Miami on Mondays and Tuesdays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Vizcaya Museum and Gardens is closed on Tuesdays and PAMM on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. The Bass, The Wolfsonian–FIU and ICA Miami close Mondays and Tuesdays, and Zak the Baker is closed on Saturdays.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: PAMM says tickets are capacity-limited and stop selling 30 minutes before closing, and Frost Science tickets are good only on the date shown. ICA Miami is free but recommends advance tickets for guaranteed entry.

toolkit.label: Free and late entry
toolkit.copy: PAMM is free on Thursdays after 5pm and stays open to 9pm that day. The Wolfsonian–FIU runs Free Fridays from 6pm to 9pm, and The Bass is free on Third Thursdays, 6–9 PM.

toolkit.label: Rules and walk-ins
toolkit.copy: Venetian Pool requires children to be at least 3 years old and 38 inches tall and stops selling tickets once at capacity. Greenstreet Cafe takes no reservations for weekend and holiday brunch until 4 PM.

guide.dek: Put Vizcaya and the museums on days they are open, book dinners ahead, and leave evenings for Little Havana music.
intro: You can build a first Miami day around Vizcaya Museum and Gardens at 3251 South Miami Ave., which opens 9:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. every day except Tuesday; its site notes ongoing conservation work in the Main House. Downtown, Pérez Art Museum Miami on Biscayne Blvd. runs "Basquiat: Figures, Signs, Symbols" through June 6, 2027 and opens "Picasso–Klee–Matisse: Masterpieces from the Museum Berggruen" on October 29, 2026. PAMM closes Tuesdays and Wednesdays, stays open to 9pm on Thursdays and is free after 5pm that evening.

Across the bay, The Bass on Collins Avenue shows "Yuko Mohri: Unviolated Imperfection" from September 17, 2026 to May 30, 2027 and opens Wednesday to Sunday, noon to 5 PM, closing for Thanksgiving on November 26. The Wolfsonian–FIU on Washington Avenue has its new "Foot Notes" exhibition and Free Fridays from 6pm to 9pm. In Wynwood and the Design District, the Wynwood Walls open daily from 10:30 AM to 6:30 PM with doors closing 30 minutes early, ICA Miami is free with advance tickets recommended, and the Rubell Museum offers free 3pm tours Wednesday to Sunday.

If you are travelling with children, Frost Science is open every day of the year and its tickets are valid only on the date shown; "The Science Behind Pixar" is included with admission. Miami Children's Museum on MacArthur Causeway opens daily from 10AM to 6PM and has its new Planet Soccer area. Zoo Miami lists Zoo Lights on select nights from November 27, 2026. For a slower outdoor day, Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden opens 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. daily with $5 off online tickets, and Coral Gables' Venetian Pool closes on Mondays.

For food, Zak the Baker in Wynwood bakes Sunday to Friday from 7am and closes on Saturdays, while Greenstreet Cafe in Coconut Grove serves breakfast from 7AM. Versailles on SW 8th Street opens from 8:00 am with its walk-up ventanita, and Joe's Stone Crab takes reservations through OpenTable. In the evening, Boia De and COTE Miami both take bookings, Café La Trova serves dinner from 5pm, and Ball & Chain in Little Havana lists live music through the week. Broken Shaker is closed Monday to Wednesday and asks you to reserve.
summaryCards: Pair Vizcaya (closed Tuesdays) with PAMM (closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays) and an evening on SW 8th Street at Versailles, Café La Trova or Ball & Chain.
Start at Zak the Baker (closed Saturdays) or Greenstreet Cafe, then walk the Wynwood Walls when they open at 10:30 AM.
Book dated tickets for Frost Science and PAMM online, reserve dinners at Boia De, COTE Miami or Joe's Stone Crab, and check that Broken Shaker is open (Thursday to Sunday only).

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Panther Coffee and Vice City Bean returned rate-limit errors, Oleta River State Park's state page refused automated reading (403), B Bistro + Bakery's domain did not resolve, Eternity Coffee Roasters had an SSL failure, Rosetta Bakery's store locator did not load, and The ScapeGoat's site gave no address, so none of these were used. All Day shows a temporary closure. Rubell Museum and Zoo Miami hours, and Greenstreet Cafe's closing time, were not published on the pages read; Boia De's hours lack AM/PM; several restaurant sites (Joe's Stone Crab, Boia De, Mandolin, Versailles, Café Demetrio, Threefold Cafe, Sweet Liberty) showed hours and booking tools but no dated 2026 content. Venetian Pool and the Coral Gables cafés are in neighbouring Coral Gables.
